data.title: 伊内丝 · 窗外的慢车
data.description: 列车开得很慢，她把随身包放到脚边。窗外的田地一块接着一块退去，伊内丝难得没有催促时间。
data.promptProse: Sitting beside the window of a slow countryside train carriage, Ines rests her cheek against the clear glass pane as she looks out at passing green fields and utility poles under soft afternoon window light.
data.animaCaption: Seated beside the window of a slow countryside train, she rests her cheek lightly against the cool glass and gazes out at passing green fields and utility poles. Soft afternoon window light diffuses across her quiet profile.
